record: Generalitat Valenciana, Palaus valencians architectural inventory
facts: Main elevation along Cavallers between the older east tower and newer west tower. Large round doorway, three storeys, rectangular lower windows, trilobed main storey windows and a small arched gallery.

record: Presidència de la Generalitat building guide
facts: Torre Vella faces the east plaza, Torre Nova faces the Plaça de Manises. The old tower balcony faces the plaza.
